ios.desc:
Create Magical Moments With Words, Music, and Motion

Tired of sending the same old birthday text or generic congratulatory messages? Make every special moment unforgettable with Screen Show – the most fun, creative, and personal way to share your words through animated text, music, and video.

Whether it’s a birthday wish, graduation shoutout, anniversary message, or just a spontaneous burst of inspiration, Screen Show lets you design and record custom video messages that are bold, colorful, musical, and uniquely you.

Say It Your Way
Bring your words to life with customizable animated text. Tap to edit your message, choose from unique animation styles like Blink, Typewriter, Loop, and more, and express yourself like never before. Add sparkle, energy, or dramatic flair – whatever the mood, there’s an effect to match.

Make It Stylish
Choose from a variety of stylish fonts to give your message just the right look. Bold, elegant, playful, handwritten – your words should look as good as they sound. Match your font to the occasion, or mix it up for extra fun.

Record & Share Instantly
Hit record and bring your message to life! Record your screen while your animated text moves. In just seconds, you’ve got a personalized video ready to share via social media, messages, email – wherever you want to spread the love.

Customize Everything

Pick your favorite background color or gradient
Drag and position your message anywhere on screen
Use custom emojis or special characters to add flair
Add multiple messages and edit each one separately
Control the size and layout to suit your style

Simple, Fun & Totally Unique
No complicated editing. No steep learning curve. Just a clean, modern design that lets you jump right into creating your next great message. Whether you’re a creator, a casual user, or someone who loves making others smile, this app gives you the tools to stand out.

Endless Possibilities
Use it for:

Birthday wishes 
Graduation messages 
Holiday greetings 
Anniversary shoutouts 
Encouraging words 
Inside jokes with friends 
"Just thinking of you" videos 
There’s no limit to what you can create. With full screen recording and musical vibes, this app helps you say more than a static card or plain text ever could.

Creator Mode Upgrade
Want to do even more? Unlock Creator Mode to:

Add more than two text messages on screen
Access exclusive animations and effects
Remove all limitations for maximum creativity
